title: Finding the Small Colorful Triangle: Door-to-Door Sperner Search
strategies: corner-guess certificate: hand in the mandatory door-to-door certificate but never verify it against the real target -- fails feasibility
exhaustive full-grid scan: query every vertex of the grid to be sure, then still build the mandatory certificate -- reproduces the checker's own worst-case baseline
row-major scan-then-certify: scan triangles in a fixed order until one is panchromatic, then bolt on the required certificate -- pays for the whole wasted scan
door-to-door path-following: exploit the boundary condition to locate the unique 0-1 entry door, then follow doors (parity argument) straight to the panchromatic triangle with no wasted queries
